rows.grounds: instrumental singular of para, indicating the next or farther yantra
instrumental singular of yantra, the ritual instrument
instrumental singular of khāta, describing the yantra as excavated or dug
locative singular of dharaṇi-tala, the surface of the earth

items.question: Which yantra is installed after the thirty-two yantras are combined?
premises: it is placed on earth surface
items.inference: the next yantra is installed beyond the thirty-two
uncertainties: exact ritual function of the dug yantra remains unclear
items.plain_english: Then, by the yantra beyond, dug into the earth's surface.
